title: Rav Tavut
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Bava Batra 49a: “Rav Pappi said: Ravina told me: A certain scholar told me — and Rav Tavut is his name — who, if they gave him all the wealth in the world, would not alter his words: ‘A case happened to me. On the eve of Shabbat a man came and asked me whether I had sesame to sell. I told him no. He said to me, “Let these zuz be deposited with you, for it is getting dark for me.” I said to him, “Here is the house before you” … and they were stolen. He came before Rava,’” etc. In Chullin 44a he resolves Rava’s words. Likewise there, at 49b, he refers to Rava’s words and says: “The power of the son (Rav Huna son of Rav Nachman) is greater than the power of the father (Rav Nachman).”

notes.text: The supplied locator Bava Batra49a is preserved; saved Davidson Bava Metzia49a contains the matching sesame narrative and the alternative name Rav Shmuel bar Zutra. חללא דעלמא means all the world’s wealth here. Saved Chullin44a/49b separately support the Rav Tavut statements, with the full Rav Nachman name in49b.

The supplied Bava Batra 49a locator is preserved. The directly matching Tavut sesame account begins in the consulted Bava Metzia 49a and continues in 49b through the deposit, theft, appearance before Rava and denial concerning the earlier incident. It also gives the alternative name Rav Shmuel bar Zutra. Chullin 44a and 49b independently name Tavut; their presence does not establish identity across every notice.
